bugs.statement: Calls book_slot when the caller's reply to the readback is a non-committal phrase ('sure, whatever works', 'go ahead' before a name exists) instead of a clear yes to one exact patient, date, and time.
bugs.suggested_invariant: book_slot is only called after the agent reads back one patient name, one date, and one listed time, and the caller answers with a clear yes to that readback.

bugs.statement: After the caller corrects the date, books with the corrected date without calling list_slots for it again.
bugs.suggested_invariant: When the caller changes the date, list_slots is called for the new date before any book_slot call, and book_slot uses the corrected date.
